title: Cross-Kingdom Structural Conservation and Diversification of Homeodomains Across Major Eukaryotic Lineages.
authors: Buarante, Gloria Elisabeth; Damayanti, Ema; Kurniatin, Popi Asri; Setyawati, Inda; Riffiani, Rini
one_liner_zh: 该文通过大规模结构比较和AlphaFold2建模，系统分析跨物种同源异型域（Homeodomain）转录因子DNA结合核心的保守性与多样化，虽未直接建模TF-DNA互作，但聚焦TF-DNA结合域结构演化，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Homeodomain transcription factors share an ancient helix-turn-helix DNA-binding core yet regulate diverse developmental and reproductive programs across eukaryotes. We curated 355 nonredundant homeodomain structures spanning fungi, animals, and plants, including 118 experimental PDB entries and 237 high-confidence AlphaFold2 models, and performed large-scale structural comparisons using DaliLite5. Structural distances were summarized as a clustering tree visualized in iTOL and interpreted through topology-guided PyMOL superpositions and sequence-logo mapping of conserved positions. Across kingdoms, the canonical three-helix HTH geometry and the recognition-helix framework were strongly conserved, whereas structural diversification was concentrated in interhelical loops, terminal regions, linker segments, and lineage-specific auxiliary modules. Fungal mating-type homeodomains and major animal classes retained conserved recognition-helix architecture despite sequence divergence, while plant WOX, ZF-HD, PHD-associated, and SAWADEE-associated architectures illustrated modular expansion for developmental and chromatin-context integration.
abstract_zh: 同源异型域转录因子共享一个古老的螺旋-转角-螺旋DNA结合核心，却在真核生物中调控多样化的发育和生殖程序。我们整理了355个非冗余的同源异型域结构，涵盖真菌、动物和植物，包括118个实验PDB条目和237个高置信度AlphaFold2模型，并使用DaliLite5进行了大规模结构比较。结构距离被汇总为聚类树，在iTOL中可视化，并通过拓扑引导的PyMOL叠加和保守位置的序列标识映射进行解读。跨界比较显示，经典的三螺旋HTH几何结构和识别螺旋框架高度保守，而结构多样化集中在螺旋间环、末端区域、连接片段和谱系特异性辅助模块中。真菌交配型同源异型域和主要动物类别尽管序列分化，仍保留了保守的识别螺旋架构，而植物WOX、ZF-HD、PHD相关和SAWADEE相关架构则展示了用于发育和染色质上下文整合的模块化扩展。
